overview_description.description:
Maison Duffour, co-founded by Alix and Rodolphe in October 2016, is an gourmet food brand delivering real food with real taste at the right price to your house everywhere in the UAE.
You can now also shop straight from our warehouse! 

Quality at a decent price is our guiding principle! We source all our products ourselves and make sure the entire chain is controlled, from the producer until your doorstep.

You can shop all our gourmet products from the comfort of your house 7 days a week. You can also pick-up your order from our shop in Al Quoz.

Shop easily on your phone or on your laptop - all our products are available online.

Shop only what's best for your family: farm cheeses, delicious breads, organic and season fruit and veggies, gourmets cold cuts and charcuterie, the best groceries with handcrafted oil, spices and sauces, gourmets desserts sources locally etc.

about_short_description.short_description: Maison Duffour is a gourmet food brand, delivering real food, with real taste, at the right price in all the UAE.

product.name: French Farm Cheeses
product.description: A selection of artisanal cheeses sourced from French farms, including varieties like Brie, Comté, Gruyère, and Beaufort.

product.name: Pork Cold Cuts and Charcuterie
product.description: A range of pork cold cuts and charcuterie products sourced from European farms, including ham, saucisson, chorizo, and sausages.

product.name: High Quality Poultry and Meat
product.description: Fresh and frozen poultry and meat products including chicken, beef, veal, lamb, and specialty cuts sourced from farms in Australia, Argentina, and Europe.

product.name: The Cheesebox Subscription
product.description: A monthly subscription service delivering a curated selection of farm cheeses to customers' doors in small or large formats.

product.name: Gourmet Grocery Products
product.description: A variety of gourmet grocery items including seasonal fruits and vegetables, pantry staples, olive oil, vinegars, and specialty condiments.

product.name: Catering Food Items
product.description: Prepared food items and finger foods including quiches, tartlets, mini pastries, and assorted savory snacks for catering purposes.
